name: Azure
description: Transform Claude into an Azure expert. This plugin integrates the Azure MCP server and specialized Azure skills to move beyond generic advice. It enables Claude to perform real-world tasks: listing resources, validating deployments, diagnosing infrastructure issues, and optimizing costs across 50+ Azure services.
longDescription:
Ships **28 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (28): `airunway-aks-setup` (Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model), `appinsights-instrumentation` (Guidance for instrumenting webapps with Azure Application Insights), `azure-ai` (Use for Azure AI: Search, Speech, OpenAI, Document Intelligence), `azure-aigateway` (Configure Azure API Management as an AI Gateway for AI models, MCP tools, and agents), `azure-app-onboard` (End-to-end orchestrator: from a business idea, app idea, or existing app to running Azure deployment with cost estimates…), `azure-app-onboard-prereq` (Assess whether source code is ready to deploy to Azure — the check BEFORE infrastructure work), `azure-cloud-migrate` (Assess and migrate cross-cloud workloads to Azure with reports and code conversion), `azure-compliance` (Run Azure compliance and security audits with azqr plus Key Vault expiration checks), and 20 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `azure`

Installs with `claude plugin install azure@claude-plugins-official` from `microsoft/azure-skills`.
